Name: New Outfit for Alex FIXED
Author: glintter
Description:
I never really loved Alex's default outfit that much so I decided to give him a new one. It's similar to his default one cause I didn't want it to feel too out of place but it's still a little different. I hope you like it!

To install drop the xnb. file into your stardew valley/content/characters folder.
If you have any requests for any other character to get a new outfit feel free to leave a comment with what you want and I might do it :) Enjoy!
